evidence.statement: After conditioning boundary-label randomization on fixed GC count and exact wildcard separation within every Panel-2 genome, same-token recurrence remains strongly above null: 59 vs analytic expectation 45.193, p=0.00018000.
Under the same stronger null, P81 is directionally above expectation but nonsignificant (p=0.1562) and model v1 is directionally above expectation but nonsignificant (p=0.0983).

The recurring token-identity boundary phenomenon is more robust than the current selected-token and graded prediction models; future models should remove simple composition/mask effects before claiming token-specific biological prediction.

unknowns: Source of residual same-token recurrence after simple composition/mask conditioning.
Whether a composition-adjusted model predicts a fresh held-out panel.
